candidates.description: Mistakes the 500 ms threshold for 500 seconds.
Waits two instead of three minutes.
Reference with only one extra constant annotation.
Uses an average rather than any-instance condition.
Retains each instance as a separate alert identity and waiting timer.
Selects one breaching instance per service but keeps its instance identity; handoff restarts the wait. Also violates output-label contract.
Either metric can trigger instead of requiring their conjunction.
Excludes the required inclusive volume boundary.
Any qualifying volume series can enable a different service.
Removes the required environment label from production alerts.
Retains for one instead of three minutes.
Fires immediately, including on a brief spike.
